name: Aubergine Hour
description: A single mauve orb gathers out of a deep plum field, its lit edge drifting through the day while the shadow side dissolves back into the room’s darkness.
listening: It listens as a slow tidal body: iBreath swells the orb’s presence, iBright tightens the rim-light, and iDay lays down a faint sediment of warmer or cooler plum as the day accumulates.

curator.verdict: This piece beautifully embodies the 'Aubergine hour' direction with its restrained palette, the deep plum ground, and a single, softly glowing orb that subtly shifts light throughout the day. Its calm, luminous quality and silent elegance resonate well with the house's mood board and tasteful restraint.
